source.title: A survey of current researches and open problems in the dimension theory of topological groups

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/4178097. Direct fetch of the zbMATH web page returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the web record was classified as blocked_or_challenged.

The zbMATH REST API exact search search_string=an:4178097 succeeded and identified Zbl 0715.54023: Dmitrij B. Shakhmatov, 'A survey of current researchs and open problems in the dimension theory of topological groups', Questions and Answers in General Topology 8, No. 1, 101-128 (1990). The API record contained no full-text links, so it was used only as identity metadata.

The publisher archive page https://qagt.org/v8n1.html was inspected and confirmed the exact issue and article listing, including D. Shakhmatov, 'A survey of current researches and open problems in the dimension theory of topological groups', pp. 101-128. The page provided only a table of contents and no article PDF or full HTML text, so it was rejected as metadata_only for extraction.

Bounded exact-work recovery used exact-title plus PDF, exact-title plus author, and journal-volume-page searches. Inspected candidates included the author's publication list, Ehime/researchmap faculty profiles, Google Books volume e45VAAAAYAAJ, the QAGT issue archive, and citation references in related papers. They were rejected because they exposed only citations, snippets, or no page access, and none contained the article's problem statements.

No readable primary PDF or full HTML source for the exact work was recovered. The map, candidate extraction, rewrite, dedupe, and quality-gate stages could not run without violating the source adequacy and no-new-facts requirements.
Saved JSON result to outputs/parse-paper/4178097.json and outputs/latest.json.
